title: Split ResponseBoardPanel into focused tab, staging, preview, and camera modules
outcome: ResponseBoardPanel now owns tab CRUD/reorder UI, the shared staging tray, staged preview, camera repair/persistence, canvas gestures, and card mutations in one large module. Extract coherent components and pure camera helpers without changing the current partitioned/legacy behavior. Centralize default-tab capability decisions during the split so UI literals do not drift from the backend contract.
acceptance: ResponseBoardPanel delegates tab bar, staging tray, staged preview, and camera helpers to focused modules with provenance headers; behavior and accessibility stay covered; default-tab delete capability is represented without a duplicated ad hoc literal; TypeScript, focused UI tests, full Vitest, and production build pass.
